summary: Newton Golf Company disclosed entry into a Loan and Security Agreement providing a $5M senior secured revolving credit facility. The facility matures July 1, 2028, with interest at Daily Simple SOFR +13% and a 22% default rate. The loan is secured by substantially all assets via a first-priority security interest. While this is a credit facility rather than a formal restructuring, the secured revolver suggests liquidity-driven capital structure support. The filing lacks stated turnaround plan; watch for subsequent covenant compliance disclosures.
